time_convention: t = frame / fps, frame 0 at t = 0; time t -> frame round(t * fps)
units: pixels (full 2048x2048 resolution, x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed

camera.vanishing_point_note: intersection of the solid white road-edge line and the dashed centre line, read on the median background; +-30 px. Far end of the road is at y~1060.
camera.focal_length: unknown - estimate from depth_info + a known size (see notes.md)
